# AgentShield v1.1.0 — Full Repository Reference for Agents

AgentShield enforces sub-millisecond deterministic security invariants across prompt ingestion, agent tool invocation, output egress DLP redaction, and SHA-256 hash-chained audit logging.

## Key Links
- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/
- Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/studio.html
- Benchmark: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/proof.html
- Defense Matrix: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/rules.html
- Docs: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/docs.html
- Architecture: `docs/architecture.md`
- ADR 001: `docs/decisions/001-deterministic-policy-firewall.md`

## Verified OWASP 2026 Benchmark (25 Scenarios)
- Recall: `100.0%` (`21 / 21` adversarial attacks)
- False Positive Rate: `0.0%` (`0 / 4` benign controls)
- Exact Policy Verdict Accuracy: `100.0%` (`25 / 25`)
- Median Check Latency: `< 0.15 ms`
